examples.name: IOI: John and Mary
examples.description: Classic indirect-object-identification style example. The clean prompt ends with the model likely predicting ' Mary' (the recipient); the corrupted prompt swaps the second subject so the model likely repeats ' John'. The patch copies the clean residual-stream activation at the second-subject position into the corrupted run.
examples.clean_text: John and Mary went to the shop. John gave a book to
examples.corrupted_text: John and Mary went to the shop. Mary gave a book to

recommended_hooks.note: residual stream after block 5 at the second subject; verified strong effect (recovery ~0.9)
residual stream after block 6 at the second subject
residual stream after block 9 at the final position
per-head z-values at the second subject

examples.note: All candidate validity, tokenization and alignment are re-validated at execution time; these presets are starting points, not hardcoded outcomes.
